200.description: YouTube Shorts for the requested channel.

lookupStatus.description: Whether the channel was resolved for this request.

url.description: Canonical public YouTube URL for the Short.

viewCount.description: View count for the Short when available.

viewCountText.description: Human-readable view count label when available.

commentCount.description: Comment count for the Short when available.

commentCountText.description: Human-readable comment count label when available.

likeCount.description: Like count for the Short when available.

likeCountText.description: Human-readable like count label when available.

genre.description: Category or genre label when available.

durationMs.description: Duration of the Short in milliseconds when available.

items.description: A single YouTube Short in the channel Shorts feed.

shorts.description: YouTube Shorts returned for the resolved channel. This array may be empty when the channel resolves but there are no Shorts in the returned page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor to pass in the next request when another page exists.

hasMore.description: Whether another page of Shorts is available.

page.description: Pagination information for the current response.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier for tracing this API call.

version.description: Public API version that served the response.

meta.description: Metadata describing the request and billing outcome.
